info.title: 3&7 Training Platform API
info.description: API for the 3&7 Training and Recovery Platform

post.description:
Register a new user.

Args:
    user_data: User registration data
    db: Database session

Returns:
    Created user

Raises:
    HTTPException: If email already registered

Authenticate and get access token.

Args:
    form_data: OAuth2 form with username (email) and password
    db: Database session

Returns:
    Token and user information

Raises:
    HTTPException: If authentication fails

Create a new training session.

Only coaches and admins can create training sessions.

get.description: Get a specific training session by ID

put.description:
Update an existing training session.

Only coaches who created the session and admins can update training sessions.

delete.description:
Delete a training session.

Only coaches who created the session and admins can delete training sessions.

post.description:
Mark attendance for multiple athletes.

Only coaches and admins can mark attendance for other athletes.

get.description: Get attendance records for a specific training session.

post.description:
Mark attendance for the currently logged-in athlete.

Athletes can only mark their own attendance.

The report includes:
- Summary of training sessions
- List of sessions with details
- Attendance stats for each session
- Feedback summary for each session

- PDF or PowerPoint if format is specified
